patterns_found.name: Double Top
patterns_found.evidence: Price has tested the 66000 resistance area twice on the right side of the chart with a pullback between the tests. Current price is declining toward the neckline support zone near 64000.

patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from bullish (higher highs and higher lows from the ~62000 low) to potential bearish as price rejected at 66000 and is now breaking down toward prior swing lows.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price rejected from the 66000 level multiple times and is currently declining toward the 64000 support zone. Volume during the recent decline appears moderate.
limitations: The latest candle may still be forming
Pattern confirmation requires a decisive close below the neckline/swing low
Exact swing levels are estimates based on visible grid lines
